description: Show the public OPERANT benchmark as calibration-profile cards (historical OCS repeats, cross-provider TPR/FPR profiles, and the metric) with a playable demo: the reader acts as the operator's agent on six cases and is scored with the real OCS = TPR - FPR. The rows are historical calculations, not a leaderboard. Hosts that support MCP Apps render it as an interactive view; others get the same data as JSON.
name: show_operant_results
title: Show OPERANT results
